spectral.true_color: High confidence: the large western field is medium to bright green; several northern, eastern and southern fields are much darker green. Extensive intervening ground is pale yellow or tan. Upper-left vegetation has irregular dark green texture. The southern central parcel is pale greenish tan.
spectral.false_color: High confidence: the large western field is bright pink-red, while the L-shaped eastern field and southern dark fields are strongly red. Upper-left woody cover varies from vivid red to dark maroon. Pale agricultural ground is mostly cyan or muted gray-green. The southern central parcel has a weak, muted pink-gray response.

implications.claim: Strong red responses identify substantial live vegetation in the western, eastern L-shaped and southern fields.
The bright western field likely has relatively continuous green cover, but display color alone does not establish superior plant health or productivity.
Pale tan areas that become cyan probably contain little green vegetation and may be bare soil, stubble, dry vegetation or mixtures of these.
Several dark true-color fields remain strongly red in false color, supporting vegetation rather than open water as their dominant cover.
The southern central parcel likely has less green vegetation cover than the strongly red neighboring parcels.
Soil or canopy moisture differences could contribute to tonal variation, but neither moisture nor irrigation can be isolated from these renderings.
No distinct open-water body is apparent; water turbidity cannot be assessed.
Small pale or gray features in the lower-left corner may include built surfaces, although their spectra overlap soil and mixed pixels.

spectral.not_revealed: High confidence: these displayed composites do not provide calibrated reflectance, quantitative vegetation indices, crop identity, yield, soil moisture, canopy temperature, water chemistry, management history or temporal change. Red intensity also depends on canopy structure, soil background and rendering stretch, so it is not a direct measure of vegetation health.

summaries.w25: High confidence: geometric agricultural fields dominate. Medium confidence: contrasting vegetation stages, pale soil or residue, and woody margins form a heterogeneous managed landscape.
summaries.w50: High confidence: this agricultural mosaic contains a large green western field, a strongly vegetated eastern L-shaped parcel and extensive pale fields. Medium confidence: woody cover concentrates toward the upper left. Spectral contrasts suggest differing vegetation cover or management stages; crop identities, season and irrigation remain unresolved.
summaries.w100: High confidence: geometric agricultural parcels dominate the 1.2 km patch. A large western field is bright green and pink-red, while an eastern L-shaped field and southern fields are dark green but strongly red in false color. Medium confidence: pale tan-to-cyan fields carry little green vegetation, potentially reflecting soil, residue or harvested cover. Woody patches concentrate toward the upper left. Low confidence: a small built cluster occupies the lower-left edge. Crop species, rotation, irrigation, moisture and exact season cannot be determined reliably from these two renderings.
summaries.w200:
High confidence: the patch is a heterogeneous agricultural mosaic with sharp parcel boundaries and mostly smooth field interiors. A large rectangular western field, approximately 540 by 400 m, contrasts with pale central ground and an eastern L-shaped vegetated field. Northern strips run approximately north–south; lower-right divisions are oblique. Medium confidence: irregular woody patches and margins concentrate toward the upper left, while a curving track crosses the southern fields. Low confidence: small lower-left bright elements belong to a farmstead or settlement.

Medium-confidence visual estimates assign 45% to vegetated agriculture, 40% to bare, sparse or residue-covered agricultural ground and 13% to woody cover; the remaining 2% represents tracks and possible built surfaces with low confidence. High confidence: strong false-color red supports live vegetation even where true color is dark. Medium confidence: tan-to-cyan parcels contain little green vegetation and represent differing cover or management stages. Crop identity, rotation, irrigation and exact season remain unresolved. A temperate setting is plausible with low confidence. No distinct water body is apparent with medium confidence.
